gui.watheextended.guidebook.title: Guidebook
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.o:
Every passenger boards the Harpy Express with a secret §orole§r and, sometimes, a §omodifier§r. Nobody is told who anyone else is. Your role decides your goal, your equipment and your abilities.

Open this guidebook at any time to look up your own role, everyone else's, and the modifiers currently in play.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.s:
Roles belong to one of three sides:

{icon:civilian} §2Civilians§r win by either surviving the journey or by killing both of the killers.
{icon:killer} §4Killers§r eliminate everyone aboard, often working together.
{icon:neutral} §6Neutrals§r may have their own objective to win, or may win alongside either the killers or the innocents.

A role marked with {icon:disabled} in the Roles tab is disabled on this server and will not appear.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.r:
Each round begins in the ready area, where players gather before departure.

To play the game, you must be boarded on the train before departure. Passengers not boarded will spectate the round.

Once the train sets off, roles are handed out and the journey proper begins.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.v:
Passengers talk to each other with §oproximity voice chat§r: you are heard by the people around you, and the further away someone stands, the quieter they get. Step out of range and they cannot hear you at all.

You can configure the voice chat by opening the menu for it using §6§l[V]§r by default, use either push-to-talk or switch to voice activation in the voice chat settings.

The same menu holds your microphone, volume and whisper controls, and lets you mute individual passengers.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.d:
Not every door aboard is open to everyone. Some are locked to a unique room key given to one or more random passengers at departure, some can be jammed shut with a {icon:lockpick} §lLockpick§r, and some open only to a specific item.

The doors on a connector carriage open onto a ladder up to the roof of the train, useful as a hiding spot and as an escape route.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.c:
{icon:coin} §6Coins§r are the currency of the Harpy Express. All killers earn money, as well as some passengers.

Money can be seen in the top-right corner of your screen, if do not see anything or if there's no items for sale in your inventory, you do not earn money.

Your main source of income as a killer is getting kills, and as a passengers, you can gain coins by either keeping your {icon:mood} §2mood§r, completing tasks or, depending on the game settings and your role, earn some income passively over time.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.a:
Many roles carry an active or passive ability. Actives are bound to your ability key: §6§l[G]§r by default, and go on cooldown once used; passives simply work.

The Abilities page of a role lists everything it can do.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.b:
A dead passenger leaves a body behind. Bodies are evidence, as well as interactable for some abilities and items.

After some time decaying however, only the skeleton will remain.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.m:
Your {icon:mood} §2mood§r is the bar and icon in the top-left corner your HUD, and it drains slowly for the whole journey. Left alone it only ever falls, you keep it up by doing the small human things, eating, drinking, sleeping, taking a breath outside...
Your current task will appear written beside the bar.

Let it sink far enough and you become §odepressed§r, and may hallucinate items in other passengers' hands, be unable to use your ability or, depending on the settings of the game, be unable to recognise familiar faces.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.v:
§bVigilantes§r start with a {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r. [Left-Click] to shoot; it kills instantly within somewhat of a long range, and it is the only reliable answer to a killer who has already reached you.

§cBe certain before you fire.§r Shooting an innocent is punished.

By default you drop your {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r and can never pick that exact same one up again, though you may still take one somebody else drops. Stricter game rules settings may stop you picking up §oany§r {icon:revolver} §lRevolvers§r for the rest of the round, or kill you outright alongside the passenger you shot.

A dead §bVigilantes§r drops their {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r where they fell, so the gun stays in play for whoever finds it.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.c:
The best strategy as a survivor is to find and stick to those you trust. §bVigilantes§r are best, but any group will do.

Just be careful not to bunch up too tightly. A crowd standing shoulder to shoulder is exactly what a killer wants for a {icon:grenade} §lGrenade§r or going {icon:psycho_mode} §lPsycho Mode§r.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.p:
Killers may {icon:poison_vial} §lPoison§r beds, drinks and food. If you can, interact with those items directly after someone else, the second drink is never poisoned!

Carrying spare food and drink is also worth it, late in the round it may be the {icon:mood} §2mood§r boost you need at a moment when you cannot safely go and fetch another.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.s:
If you are one of the last few survivors, your first priority is finding a {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r. Dead §bVigilantes§r drop theirs where they fell, so it is worth searching the train.

Hiding and timing the killer out is the alternative, but some of them may have {icon:instinct} §4Instinct§r and can see you through walls, so hiding rarely holds. Taking risks to find the {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r is usually the better bet.

Once you have one, hold a long line of sight down a carriage rather than a corner. The extra distance is the time you need to react and shoot first.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.i:
{icon:instinct} §4Instinct§r is your most important tool. Hold §6§l[Left-Alt]§r to see every player and fallen items through the walls of the train, your §4Killer Cohorts§r included.

Use it before you commit to anything: check that a carriage is empty before you draw a weapon, count how many passengers are grouped in the next car, follow a target through a wall instead of down a corridor, and pick your moment on a straggler.
It is also the only way to see anything during a {icon:blackout} §lBlackout§r.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.k:
The best strategy as a killer is to use your {icon:instinct} §4Instinct§r as much as possible. As soon as you spot a lone player, take the opportunity.

If you can work out who the §bVigilantes§r are, stay away from them entirely, you lose nothing by waiting, they'll kill you instantly if they get the shot!

The {icon:knife} §lKnife§r is your most useful item in the game. Hold §6§l[Right-Click]§r to brandish it, then release while your crosshair is on your victim once the sound finishes to kill them.

[Left-Click] applies knockback instead, on no cooldown at all, enough to shove a passenger off the train.

The {icon:knife} §lKnife§r makes sounds when being branded and when stabbing someone, be sure to be separated from lurkers when killing a passenger.
On a side-note, you can't just brand the {icon:knife} §lKnife§r indefinitely, after 3 seconds of branding it continuously, your arm will drop of fatigue forcing you to rebrand the {icon:knife} §lKnife§r.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.l:
If your identity has been revealed and you need to get away, buy the {icon:lockpick} §lLockpick§r. You can open the connector doors up onto the roof of the train by doing §6§l[Right-Click]§r on it.
You can also temporally jam doors behind you using §6§l[Shift] + [Right-Click]§r
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.g: The {icon:grenade} §lGrenade§r can kill multiple grouped passengers at once, which is both a boon and a curse, it will take a group in the next carriage, and it will take you as well if you are too close. Mind your own position before you throw.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.b:
The {icon:blackout} §lBlackout§r cuts every light aboard.

Use {icon:instinct} §4Instinct§r to see your surroundings and the passengers while it lasts, they'll have a hard time seeing you at all.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.p:
In {icon:psycho_mode} §lPsycho Mode§r, do not spam click. Time each swing with the attack indicator instead.

While being in that form, you cannot interact with anything except lamps and unlocked doors, you cannot switch off the {icon:bat} §lBat§r until the end of it.

You are also invulnerable to one {icon:revolver} §lRevolver§r shot, after being shot once, the second shot will be fatal.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.guide.desc.c:
You may find that the survivors group up so heavily that a kill is almost impossible.

If that happens, work for one kill first so you can afford an expensive option:
The {icon:blackout} §lBlackout§r, {icon:psycho_mode} §lPsycho Mode§r or the {icon:grenade} §lGrenade§r all deal with a crowd far better than a {icon:knife} §lKnife§r does.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.wa: Just an ordinary face in the crowd, the Civilian is no different from anyone else on board, or is it? They're traveling for any number of reasons, whether it be business, leisure, a well-earned vacation, or simply a luxury voyage.

One of the most vital figures aboard the Harpy Express, the Vigilante's presence is not only important, it is essential. Their role is to guarantee that every passenger reaches their destination safely, keeping trouble at bay and maintain the order throughout the journey. It is recommended to not bother the Vigilante, as they are known to be very protective of their fellow passengers and will not hesitate to take action against anyone who poses a threat to the safety of the train.

A merciless serial killer, their unique objective is to eliminate everyone aboard using whatever they can. Often operating alongside their §4Killer Cohorts§r, their true motives remain a chilling mystery for what brought them here, and why they are so intent on leaving no one alive.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ki: The Bellringer, they never separate their arm from their watch, being always aware of the train's schedule, they knows exactly when the train will reach each stations.

A seasoned cinema makeup artist, the Bodymaker possesses deep expertise in human anatomy and the craft of disguise. Drawing on the skills acquired throughout their career, they are capable of fabricating convincing fake corpses, a talent they've weaponized to derail investigations and instill fear in their targets, ultimately making it far easier to make real victims.

While being a brutal, cold-blooded murderer, the Cleaner is also a very tidy person, they can't stand any mess around them. They will do anything to clean up the mess, even when killing people. They can dissolve corpses using their Sulfuric Acid Barrel, leaving no traces about the incident, not even dropped items and blood stains.

The Cook, a close friend of the Bartender, specializes in preparing rich and delicious meals in the Harpy Express. Their dedication to their craft is unmatched, give 'em their Pan, and they're ready to work their magic!

A skilled investigator, the Detective will do anything to find out the truth. With their sharp intellect and analytical skills, they are adept at solving mysteries and uncovering hidden secrets. The Detective's abilities allow them to gather crucial information about other players, making them a valuable asset in the quest for justice aboard the train.

The Dreamer, known to be a really strange individual. Some people called out that the Dreamer were imprinting stuff on other people, but no one really knows what is it, some people say that this mysterious substance saved their life. Overall the Dreamer is a very odd person, and no one really knows what they are capable of and why they are doing all that.

A professional drug maker, the Drugmaker is a passenger who has a deep understanding of various substances and their effects. With their expertise in chemistry and pharmacology, they are able to create a wide range of drugs that can have different effects on those who consume them. They often use their knowledge to concoct powerful and dangerous substances, which are used to kill people without raising suspicion.

A psychotic and bloodthirsty serial killer, the Hunter is a passenger who has a deep obsession with hunting and killing other passengers. They are driven by an insatiable desire to stalk and eliminate their prey, finding a twisted sense of satisfaction in the act of taking lives. With their cunning and predatory instincts, the Hunter is a formidable and dangerous individual who poses a significant threat to the safety of everyone on board.

Fair and just, the Judge is a passenger who upholds the principles of justice and righteousness. With a strong sense of morality and a commitment to fairness, the Judge is dedicated to ensuring that justice is served aboard the train. They are known for their impartiality and their unwavering dedication to upholding the law, making them a respected figure among the passengers.

Shifty and effective, the Kidnapper loves abducting and holding its victims captive. They always use they Knockout Drug sheet to daze their target and drag them to their desired place, the imbibed drug is so strong that the victim will drop unconscious on the spot, making it easier for the Kidnapper to take them away without any resistance.

A lone wolf, the Licensed Villain operates alone, deprived of any sentimental attachment or alliance. They're searching for their individual gain, not caring about the consequences of their actions on others. They are driven by a desire for power, wealth, or personal satisfaction, and they will stop at nothing to achieve their goals, meaning that if everyone needs to be killed, everyone will be killed.

The Physician is a renowned figure in science, particularly in the study of deadly plants, poisons, and toxins. Globally recognized for discovering a cure for methanol poisoning, their presence aboard the Harpy Express is essential to safeguard its high-class passengers, especially those who may be targeted by malintentioned individuals from any assassination attempts involving poison.

A highly advanced and sophisticated machine, the Robot is a "passenger" that serves as a source of entertainment and amusement for the other passengers. Deprived of any emotions the Robot will never feel depressed, lonely or scared, making it the perfect candidate for testing dangerous and risky stuff without any consequences.

The Hacker, a skilled black hat that work alongside well-known serial-killers. With their expertise in technology and computer systems, they can setup private and secured communication systems to work with their Killer Cohorts. Their abilities allow them to help their fellow companions on having the job done faster than usual and to gather valuable information about other passengers, must stay safe over the Internet...
The technician is prepared for any scenario, able to fix jammed doors, blackouts, and has a capture device to trap passing players.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.no: As silly as they can be, they love to have fun and make jokes, often by writing down ridiculous things on their Notes and sticking them all around the place for whatever reason. How many Notes do they have? Can someone please tell them to stop sticking those Notes everywhere?

The Bartender is a skilled mixologist who serves up a variety of cocktails to the passengers. However, the Bartender's talents extend beyond just mixing drinks, they also have a keen sense for detecting when someone has recently enjoyed one of their cocktails, how is this even possible?

Just like the Vigilante, the Better Vigilante is the highest class of security personnel aboard the Harpy Express, responsible for ensuring the safety and well-being of all passengers. Since the Better Vigilante is a more experienced and skilled version of the Vigilante, they are given access to an additional tool alongside their Revolver to ensure the safety of the passengers inside the train, a... GRENADE?!

The master of the train, the Conductor. Their goal is to keep the train running smoothly, ensuring that all passengers reach their destinations safely. With a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of the train's mechanics, the Conductor is responsible for maintaining order and efficiency throughout the journey. With their unique abilities, they can keep track of lost items and ensure that all doors are accessible to those who need them.

One of the most skilled investigator who's specialized in examining the deceased to uncover the truth behind their demise. With their expertise by working alongside the medical examiners, the Coroner meticulously inspects dead bodies to gather crucial information about the victim's cause of death, who they were and when did they died.

Hired by a mysterious organization, the Executioner is tasked with a grim and dangerous mission: eliminate a designated target. To avoid suspicion and maintain secrecy, they are deprived of any lethal weapons, forcing them to depend on manipulation, strategy, and careful planning to get the job done. Their objective is to ensure the target's death by any means available. If they succeed, they earn a promotion, rising into the ranks of a §4Killer§r.

A mischievous and unpredictable fool, thrives on chaos. With a penchant for trickery, the Jester's primary objective is to sow discord among players, often by misleading them about their true intentions. Are they telling the truth or are they manipulating everyone to achieve their goal ? Whether it's through pretending to be a good or a bad person, the Jester keeps everyone on edge.

The Mimic, a master of imitation and usurpation, aware that dangerous individuals are hunting others, they came up with a smart plan: blend in by becoming one of them. Unfortunately, to avoid trouble with the security, they only carry a §lFake Knife§r as part of the disguise. To other §4Killers§r, they appear as one of the §4Killer Cohorts§r. By using this undercover tactic, the Mimic may be able to secretly identify and expose the real §4Killers§r to other passengers.

The master of disguise, capable of taking on the appearance and name of another player. This ability allows the Morphling to blend seamlessly into the crowd, making it difficult for others to identify their real identity. With these unique skills, they can gaslight other players about their true identity.

A simple-minded troublemaker, the Noisemaker delights in irritating others by setting off firecrackers. But their disruptive behaviour can have serious consequences, some people don't take these pranks very kindly. As frustration grows, the Noisemaker may even receive death threats, realizing they've made themselves a target.

The Phantom is a mysterious and elusive figure, shrouded in an aura of enigma. They are described as a shadowy presence that can move undetected through the environment. The Phantom's abilities allow them to become invisible to the human eye, allowing them to slip past unsuspecting players and strike when least expected.

The one who can manipulate space and time. The Recaller is able to set a recall point and instantly return to it whenever needed. This power allows them to move strategically through their surroundings, escaping danger or repositioning for a tactical advantage. However, their ability cannot be used freely, as overuses may trigger unintended side effects.

The Swapper draws inspiration from urban legends in which mysterious beings are said to possess the power to instantly switch the positions of two people, teleporting them back and forth in the blink of an eye to kill one of them without anyone noticing their disappearance. People recently affirmed that this happened recently, often in closed areas and mostly at night time.

A formerly retired hunter, the Trapper has a knack for setting up traps to ensnare and catch small animals. However, their skills have taken a darker turn as they now use their expertise to set up traps to spy and stalk on unsuspecting victims. With a deep understanding of the terrain and a keen eye for detail, the Trapper can strategically place traps in tactical areas, allowing them to gather valuable information about other people's privacy.

A sinister and malevolent entity, embodying the dark arts of voodoo magic. The Voodoo is capable to establish a mystical connection with another being, linking their fates together in a twisted bond. Everything that can happen to the Voodoo will also happen to the linked being, making them a puppet in the Voodoo's hands.

Some people may also call them, the Cannibal, as they have an insatiable hunger for dead corpses. Their primary objective is to eat the remains of fallen players, consuming enough corpses to satisfy their hunger and ultimately transform into a formidable §4Killer§r. Gross...

A doomed soul, the infected prefers company in the afterlife. Its objective is to infect the entire train. Their primary ability is to infect nearby players. Cursing them to a a very slow death.
 Infection may also spread when players interact with items dropped by the infected. The infection can be cured by a defense vial.
An intelligent killer that chooses his victims carefully, the Recon spawns with three role mines that can reveal the roles of their victims before their untimely demise.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.st: Silence is key, the Muzzler favors a stealthy and silent approach, using their unique approach: muzzle their victim or witnesses so they can't call for help, often killing them in the process.

A supernatural athlete, the Starstruck is capable of achieving incredible feats of agility and speed, making them a formidable competitor in any physical challenge. With their extraordinary abilities, the Starstruck can flee from danger with ease, that the cost of flashing everyone close to them as they start running, close your eyes!

Waking up in an unfamiliar train with no memory of who they are or how they got there, the Amnesiac is a passenger plagued by a complete loss of identity. Struggling to piece together fragments of their past, they navigate the train with a sense of confusion and vulnerability. Upon looking at other people, they may experience brief flashes of memory, but these glimpses are fleeting and often leave them with more questions than answers. They may find a way to retrieve their memories, but how?

A dangerous individual with a penchant for fire, the Arsonist is a passenger who harbors a destructive obsession. They are driven by an insatiable desire to set things to blazes, finding a twisted sense of satisfaction in watching flames consume their surroundings. Their worst fantasy is to burn alive a ton of people at the same time.

The Avaricious, a sneaky individual driven by an insatiable desire for wealth and material possessions, stealing from other passengers by being very close to them without ever getting caught. They are cunning and resourceful, always on the lookout for opportunities to acquire valuable items and money.

Upon boarding the train, they saw it, their nemesis, the other Initiate. They immediately felt a strong hatred towards them, and they know that they are the only one who can stop them. They will do anything to eliminate the other Initiate, there's not enough space in the train for two of them.

Capable of reviving the dead as their minions. The Necromancer have a dark and twisted fascination with death, seeking to harness its power for their own nefarious purposes. With the ability to raise fallen passengers as undead servants, the Necromancer can use them to accomplish their sinister goals, whether it's for killing other people or scare them.

A lone wolf looking for valuable items to steal, the Thief has a deep obsession with acquiring valuable possessions. Their favorite valuables they like to steal are collection knives and guns, they will do anything to get their hands on them, so you should probably close any of your opened pockets when you see them around, just in case.
